description:
Having just become an adult, Ji-ho is more innocent than most college freshmen—thanks to being doted on and sheltered by his neighbours, the twin brothers Sung-jun and Sung-yeon. At Ji-ho’s birthday party, the twins decide to “teach” him something special… to mark his coming of age.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000055008), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12253811), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/1286009311), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/perfect_connections), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/perfect_connection)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://honto.jp/ebook/pd-series_C-MBJ-21782-7-611267X.html)

**Note:** The second story from series [Dagong Igseon](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=19455005714).
